<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1758202_demo.PDFGeneratorUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PDFGeneratorUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PDFGeneratorUtil = Class.create();
PDFGeneratorUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
    
    /**
     * 生成PDF并返回附件sys_id
     * @param {string} tableName - 表名
     * @param {string} recordSysId - 记录sys_id
     * @param {string} templateId - (可选)PDF模板ID
     * @return {object} {status: string, message: string, attachmentSysId: string}
     */
    generatePDF: function(tableName, recordSysId, templateId) {
        var result = {
            status: 'error',
            message: '',
            attachmentSysId: ''
        };
        
        try {
            // 验证记录存在
            var gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            if (!gr.get(recordSysId)) {
                result.message = '记录不存在: ' + recordSysId;
                return result;
            }
            
            // 创建PDF渲染器
            var renderer = new PDFRenderer();
            var fileName = 'Document_' + gr.getDisplayValue() + '.pdf';
            
            // PDF生成选项
            var options = {
                table: tableName,
                sys_id: recordSysId,
                filename: fileName
            };
            
            // 如果提供了模板ID
            if (templateId) {
                options.template = templateId;
            }
            
            // 生成PDF
            var pdf = renderer.render(options);
            if (!pdf) {
                result.message = 'PDF生成失败';
                return result;
            }
            
            // 将PDF作为附件附加到记录
            var attachment = new GlideSysAttachment();
            var attachmentSysId = attachment.write(pdf, tableName, recordSysId, fileName, 'application/pdf');
            
            result.status = 'success';
            result.attachmentSysId = attachmentSysId;
            return result;
            
        } catch (e) {
            result.message = '生成PDF时出错: ' + e.message;
            gs.error('PDFGeneratorUtil错误: ' + e.message);
            return result;
        }
    },
    
    type: 'PDFGeneratorUtil'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-05 06:19:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>87d2737f9779e2101c50f91de053afd7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PDFGeneratorUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Demo" source="x_1758202_demo">f06f80349735ae501c50f91de053afca</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Demo">f06f80349735ae501c50f91de053afca</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_87d2737f9779e2101c50f91de053afd7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-05 06:46:18</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
